statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on all OCI load balancers and network load balancers in scope
statements.query: MATCH (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (n:OCILoadBalancer OR n:OCINetworkLoadBalancer) AND n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Mark public (is_private false) load balancers as exposed if a security list of one of their subnets admits a listener's protocol and port from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Listener targets are '<protocol>:<port>' ('any' protocol / port 0 = every one); rule ranges are '<protocol>:<min>-<max>' ('all' = every protocol). Security lists synced before internet_ingress_port_ranges existed count as open on every port when they admit any internet ingress.
statements.query: MATCH (lb)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (lb:OCILoadBalancer OR lb:OCINetworkLoadBalancer) AND coalesce(lb.is_private, false) = false MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet) WHERE subnet.id IN coalesce(lb.subnet_ids, []) MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) WITH lb, coalesce(sl.internet_ingress_port_ranges, CASE WHEN coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') THEN ['all:1-65535'] ELSE [] END) AS ranges WHERE any(t IN coalesce(lb.listener_targets, []) WHERE any(r IN ranges WHERE (split(t, ':')[0] = 'any' OR split(r, ':')[0] IN ['all', split(t, ':')[0]]) AND (split(t, ':')[1] = '0' OR (toInteger(split(split(r, ':')[1], '-')[0]) <= toInteger(split(t, ':')[1]) AND toInteger(split(split(r, ':')[1], '-')[1]) >= toInteger(split(t, ':')[1]))))) WITH DISTINCT lb SET lb.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress' IN coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN lb END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress'

statements.__comment: Mark public load balancers as exposed if one of their NSGs has a rule admitting a listener's protocol and port from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. Rules synced before internet_ingress_port_range existed count as open on every port.
statements.query: MATCH (lb)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (lb:OCILoadBalancer OR lb:OCINetworkLoadBalancer) AND coalesce(lb.is_private, false) = false MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(lb.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH lb, collect(coalesce(rule.internet_ingress_port_range, 'all:1-65535')) AS ranges WHERE any(t IN coalesce(lb.listener_targets, []) WHERE any(r IN ranges WHERE (split(t, ':')[0] = 'any' OR split(r, ':')[0] IN ['all', split(t, ':')[0]]) AND (split(t, ':')[1] = '0' OR (toInteger(split(split(r, ':')[1], '-')[0]) <= toInteger(split(t, ':')[1]) AND toInteger(split(split(r, ':')[1], '-')[1]) >= toInteger(split(t, ':')[1]))))) SET lb.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress' IN coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN lb END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a public load balancer with listeners whose subnets, subnet security lists or NSGs are not all in the graph (other compartment, not synced) cannot be proven closed, so it is exposed
statements.query: MATCH (lb)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (lb:OCILoadBalancer OR lb:OCINetworkLoadBalancer) AND coalesce(lb.is_private, false) = false AND size(coalesce(lb.listener_targets, [])) > 0 OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet) WHERE subnet.id IN coalesce(lb.subnet_ids, []) WITH lb, collect(DISTINCT subnet) AS subnets WITH lb, subnets, apoc.coll.toSet(reduce(ids = [], s IN subnets | ids + coalesce(s.security_list_ids, []))) AS sl_ids OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN sl_ids WITH lb, subnets, sl_ids, count(DISTINCT sl) AS known_security_lists OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(lb.nsg_ids, []) WITH lb, subnets, sl_ids, known_security_lists, count(DISTINCT nsg) AS known_nsgs WHERE size(subnets) < size(apoc.coll.toSet(coalesce(lb.subnet_ids, []))) OR known_security_lists < size(sl_ids) OR known_nsgs < size(apoc.coll.toSet(coalesce(lb.nsg_ids, []))) SET lb.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_lb_unresolved_rules' IN coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN lb END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(lb.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_lb_unresolved_rules'

statements.__comment: Build publicContext JSON for exposed load balancers. resourceType is the inventory service each label is expected to map to.
statements.query: MATCH (lb)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE (lb:OCILoadBalancer OR lb:OCINetworkLoadBalancer) AND lb.exposed_internet = true SET lb.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: lb.id, resourceType: CASE WHEN lb:OCILoadBalancer THEN 'oci-networking-loadbalancer-loadbalancer' ELSE 'oci-networking-networkloadbalancer-networkloadbalancer' END, context: [{loadBalancerId: lb.id, loadBalancerName: lb.display_name, publicIps: coalesce(lb.public_ip_addresses, []), listenerPorts: coalesce(lb.listener_ports, []), listenerTargets: coalesce(lb.listener_targets, []), subnetIds: coalesce(lb.subnet_ids, []), nsgIds: coalesce(lb.nsg_ids, []), backendIps: coalesce(lb.backend_ips, []), backendInstanceIds: coalesce(lb.backend_target_ids, []), exposureTypes: lb.exposed_internet_type, region: lb.region}]}])
